name: drop-prep-4am
description: Overnight debugging before ~4am Target drop — no user on PC required for Node/browser-smoke tier
goals: All verify.sh and browser-smoke gates green every cycle
Document blocked live-rehearsal if credentials absent on host
Ready for drop: polling math verified, extension smoke PASS
nonGoals: Live purchase or auto place order
Require user at keyboard during cycles
technicalNotes: Boss agent: @it. Drop time via TCH_DROP_EXPECTED_AT (ISO). Cycles: scripts/drop-prep-cycle.mjs. Live Target rehearsal only if scripts/browser-smoke/.env.rehearsal exists on host. Set CURSOR_API_KEY for nested agent batches in loop.sh.
_step_size: One fix per commit when agent batch runs; cycle logs always append.

requirements.description: Extension smoke: xvfb-run npm run test:extension in browser-smoke
verification: cd scripts/browser-smoke && xvfb-run -a npm run test:extension

requirements.description: Bug hunt: checkout sign-in + drop tension (content.js, signinStep.js)
acceptance: Review checkout pending + drop window toast paths
Fix bugs with signin-step or checkout-speed tests

requirements.description: Bug hunt: background monitor + harvest keepalive near drop (background.js)
Optional live rehearsal if .env.rehearsal on host; else stuck with blockedReason
acceptance: If .env.rehearsal exists: npm run checkout-rehearsal or document failure code
If missing: stuck true blockedReason missing_credentials (expected on cloud)
requirements.blockedReason: target_checkout_auth_modal — cloud rehearsal reaches new checkout sign-in UI (email+Continue) but password step never appears; Target may show 'Something went wrong' under automation. Manual sign-in on your PC before drop still works.

requirements.description: Pre-drop summary in drop-prep-notes.md before TCH_DROP_EXPECTED_AT
acceptance: Notes list cycle timestamps, pass/fail gates, fixes committed
Reminder: one Target tab, clear cart, extension ON before drop
